title: Driven Brands Holdings Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-23
summary: Driven Brands Holdings Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing that its wholly-owned subsidiaries received a waiver (WBS Waiver) under the Second Amended and Restated Base Indenture dated October 20, 2025. The waiver extends multiple financial reporting deadlines: the 2025 Form 10-K deadline moved to June 10, 2026, quarterly financial statement deadlines extended to 45 days after annual statements are delivered, and auditor report deadlines extended to 30 days after the latest annual financial statement delivery date.
key_points: Driven Brands' U.S. Manager and Canadian Manager received WBS Waiver on April 22, 2026
2025 Form 10-K (fiscal year ended December 27, 2025) delivery deadline extended to June 10, 2026
Quarterly financial statements for Q1 2026 (ending March 28, 2026) deadline extended to 45 days after annual statements delivery
Co-Issuer Reports deadline extended to 30 days after latest annual financial statement delivery
Filing relates to ABS indenture between Driven Brands Funding LLC (Issuer), Driven Brands Canada Funding Corporation (Canadian Co-Issuer), and Citibank N.A. as trustee
Company expects to deliver 2025 Form 10-K on or before June 10, 2026
